title: Phase 3: static jev/v1 fixture validation for `fake-jev validate`
objective: Implement the statically provable jev/v1 fixture-data consistency checks required by specification §15.2, so that `fake-jev validate` validates all enabled profile-specific fixture data and performs all statically possible consistency checks, without starting a server or making any network request.
nonGoals: no change to runtime request validation
no change to response generation at serve time
no server startup and no network access
nextAction: implement the static answers/helper validation and the when.questions to then.answers cross-check, call it from validate, and cover it with tests
notes: Opened 2026-09-29 by PM as the explicit owner of the clause in C-CLI-005 and §15.2 that FJ-030 could not satisfy inside its allowedFiles.

G1: inner jev/v1 then.answers payloads are not validated at load time today; probability ranges, finite values, and maps summing to 1.0 within 1e-6 are only enforced later in internal/compat/jev/v1/fixture.go at response-generation time.
G2: the stub's when.questions key set is not cross-checked against then.answers keys, although both are statically known from the configuration file.

Design constraint: internal/config is provider-neutral and must not import internal/compat/jev/v1 (enforced by cmd/guard arch); the static validator belongs in the compat layer and must be invoked from the CLI composition root.
Not statically decidable: choice/score criterion key-set equality, because criteria come from the incoming client request, not from the configuration.
